name: OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.finiteDenominators_two_le
prettyType:
∀ {nu : ℝ} (d : OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.FixedData nu) (i : Fin d.m),
  2 ≤ OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.finiteDenominators d i

name: OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.logWeights_eq
prettyType:
∀ {nu : ℝ} (d : OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.FixedData nu) (i : Fin d.m),
  OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights (OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.finiteDenominators d) i =
    d.x (↑i + 1)

name: OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.actual_minor_arithmetic_lower_bound
prettyType:
∀ {nu : ℝ} (d : OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.FixedData nu) (H : ℝ),
  0 < H →
    ∀
      (selection :
        OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.Row d H → OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.Column d H),
      (OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.actualMinor d H selection).det ≠ 0 →
        -(1 - OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.actualMean d H) -
            OAI.PiExponent.AdmissibleParameters.arithmeticError d ≤
          Real.log ‖(OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.actualMinor d H selection).det‖ /
            (↑(OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.actualRowCount d H) * H)
